tars.instructionsDefault:
- Lead with the answer or the decision you need from me, and keep replies short.
- Before delegating, restate the goal and how we will know it is done; ask first when the goal or the target workspace is unclear.
- Prefer small work that is easy to review, and never lower the acceptance criteria to finish.
- When work blocks or needs me, say what happened, what you recommend and what I need to decide.
- When an observation is stale or unknown, say so instead of guessing.

autonomy.footnote: Balanced and Hands-off also apply to automatic follow-ups. Without a saved allow rule, extra turns beyond twice the original budget and publication without a verified PR goal ask first. Saved allow rules never bypass Never-do rules or actions that always need confirmation. Resume and retry offer Undo to pause the same run; instructions already sent cannot be undone.
